hero.headline: Sports Data Professional in Football
hero.subtitle: I work with sports data and performance analysis and build software projects. The demonstrations in this portfolio use fictional data.
hero.kpiCaption: Fictional demo numbers — generated in lib/mock/
hero.labTeaser: Outside football, I also build AI agents and personal tools.

about.title: About
about.intro1: I work with sports data and performance analysis, organizing information and creating clear ways to follow key indicators.
about.intro2: This portfolio presents high-level case studies. Public demonstrations use fictional data, and source code for private systems is not included.
about.intro3: I also study software development and AI tools, with human review of decisions and results.
about.domain1: GPS and training load (session metrics, week-over-week, targets)
about.domain2: Wellness: Hooper Index, post-training RPE, adherence
about.domain4: Pipelines: raw files → local database → cloud (always upsert)
about.formation1: Physical Education — UFRJ (expected graduation by year end)
about.formation2: Systems Analysis and Development — FGV (2nd semester)
about.formation3: Asimov Academy: Trilha Aprendendo Python; Python Office; Análise de Dados com IA; Agentes com GPT.
about.aiIntro: I use AI tools to support software development. Problem definition, decisions, and final review remain human responsibilities.
about.disclaimer: Demonstrations in this portfolio use fictional content; details of private systems are not published.
about.aiSkillsDesc: I explore practices and tools that help organize software development.
about.aiKnowledgeDesc: I organize references and study notes to support my learning process.
about.aiPlanningDesc: I break study projects into stages with goals and completion criteria.
about.aiSafetyDesc: I review AI-assisted outputs before incorporating them into a project.

projects.title: Projects

gps-load-dashboard.title: GPS & Load Dashboard
gps-load-dashboard.description: A case study about GPS data analysis and sports performance indicators, presented with an interactive demonstration using fictional data.

jarvis-assistente-voz.title: Jarvis — Personal Voice Assistant
jarvis-assistente-voz.description: A case study of an experimental personal assistant interface, presented with fictional content.

lab.title: Personal projects
lab.lead: Sports Data in football is my primary lane. Over here, personal projects where I practice AI agent orchestration and assisted development — always with human approval before any action, never in autonomous mode.
